title: Step 0 of the third-round programme: deposit list
written_by: the step-0 agent (a model agent working for the project lead; not a person)
status: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10. Labels are model-coded and not checked by a person; step-0 text fields are rule-based and not checked by a person.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.
rulings: Lead's rulings of 2026-11-26: 1 (the ledger hash, first and alone, by a public commit to the registry; GitHub's merge time is the external time stamp) and 2 (the r3-P29 deposit with r3-P30, r3-P31, r3-P34 and r4-P33, citing the ledger hash). No class-a run starts before the second commit is merged.
